system.description:
• Effect: Declare before making the attack roll.
  • On a hit, the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is Stunned for 1 round (1d4 rounds from 10th level).
  • A creature that saves cannot be stunned by your Stun Attack again until the end of the encounter.
  • Deals normal unarmed damage.
  • Usable once per round, limited to once per level per day — a missed attack counts against the daily limit
  • First stun attempt must be a primary attack
